product_metadata.title: Happy Wax Savory Mix Scented Natural Soy Wax Melts – 8 Oz. of Scented Wax Melts, Made in USA
features: Fall Favorites - A cozy, rich seasonal mix of Cinnamon Chai, Apple Harvest, and Pumpkin Soufflé scented soy wax melts.
Infused With Essential Oils - All of our natural wax melts are infused with the finest essential oils! Enjoy the finest, freshest, safest melting experience.

Long-Lasting Scents - Each 6 Ounce Collection Pack yields 150 hours of flame-free home fragrance! Our scented soy wax melts are packed with paraffin-free and phthalate-free fragrance for a premium scent experience!
Made in USA - All Happy Wax Melts are lovingly made locally at our factory in North Carolina.
Great for all occasions and environments – Enjoy these pet-friendly, child-friendly wax melts in your home or office. Works great in bathrooms, living rooms, kitchens, and more!
